d:
The official English version (and uncensored) release of the Kemoshonen vol. 3. This is also the official digital release version. At the end of the gallery are the animated promo version of the volume's cover, and static, full color crops of the cover mascots that were sourced from promotional material posted on Kemonoshonen's social medi, which I added simply 'cuz the full versions in the book aren't in color, and the cover page partially cover each other.

Official Digital + uncensored version available (in multiple languages) for purchase here:

https://www.doujin.com.tw/books/info/69817

Also available on booth, but STILL CENSORED:
https://kemoshonen.booth.pm/items/8680119

This volume contains a story from Kami no Saki, uncensored works from that artist are a true rarity! Also, Draugnut's story features the boys from the cover of the first volume, finally! Even though the sexual stuff was short-lived, at least we got more of them that isn't just the concept arts from Draugnut's social media pages. One last thing is that the afterward message from Koiyaroid was originally written in Korean, I had to wait a while before posting this volume to confirm that this was a mistake and for the proper message to be included in the store's page after the correction, which is why my posting of the English version was later than normal, speaking of that message, it seems like Koiyaroid intends to submit a story involving this volume's cover mascots in the next volume of Kemoshonen, so look out for that! I know I'm looking forward to her story about them!
